components.name: Badge
components.summary: Badge is a small status or count label, wrapping the Web Awesome badge as orderly-badge.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Breadcrumb is a trail of links showing where the user is in a hierarchy, wrapping the Web Awesome breadcrumb as boss-breadcrumb.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Button is the action control for a view, wrapping the Web Awesome button as orderly-button with Orderly variants and sizes.

components.name: Callout
components.summary: Callout is an inline message block with an optional action and dismiss, wrapping the Web Awesome callout as boss-callout.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Checkbox is the form selection control, wrapping the Web Awesome checkbox as orderly-checkbox at small size.

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: Combobox is the type-to-find list control, wrapping the Web Awesome combobox as boss-combobox (single) and boss-multi-combobox (multi).

components.name: Details
components.summary: Details is a collapsible panel that reveals secondary content under a summary, wrapping the Web Awesome details element as boss-details.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Input is the single-line text field, wrapping the Web Awesome input as boss-input with an Orderly label, hint and masking.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Select is the pick-from-a-list control, wrapping the Web Awesome select as boss-select (single) and boss-multi-select (multi).

components.name: Switch
components.summary: Switch is the immediate on/off control, wrapping the Web Awesome switch as boss-switch with the brand orange checked colour.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Tag is a compact chip for filter values and multi-select selections, wrapping the Web Awesome tag as boss-tag.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Textarea is the multi-line text field, wrapping the Web Awesome textarea as boss-wa-textarea with an Orderly label and hint.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: Toggle is a segmented control for choosing one of a few options, wrapping a Web Awesome radio group of button-style radios as boss-toggle.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Tooltip is a short hint bubble anchored to an element, wrapping the Web Awesome tooltip as boss-tooltip.
